lines.arrive: The long way home with your friend, along the boardwalk through the swamp.
lines.strike_1: Lightning. It takes your friend apart, all of them, in an instant.
lines.strike_2: And by sheer chance, at the same moment, it turns the dead tree into an exact copy of your friend. Every atom in place. Every memory.
lines.seems: It seems to know you. It seems to remember. But a minute ago, it was a tree.
lines.again: The storm's coming round again. There's another dead tree, just off the path.
lines.dog: The dog wags its tail at you. It won't go near your friend.
lines.frogs: Two frogs on the lily pad, where there used to be one. They look at each other.
lines.home_idle: Your friend takes your arm, and walks you home.
lines.home_1: You go in together. Your friend knows where the mugs are, and that you take two sugars.
lines.home_2: Nobody will ever know the difference. Did your friend remember you? Or only seem to?
